SOUPARNO DARIPA

LinkedIn :  linkedin/souparno-daripa ⋄ GitHub :  github/souparno-daripa

+91 980 453 2096 ⋄ Email : souparnorbk2@gmail.com ⋄ devfolio/souparno

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

Results-driven Software Engineer with 9 years’ experience architecting, building, and delivering scalable, high-performing distributed systems for healthcare, fintech, and customer success domains. Proficient in system design, migration from monolith to microservices, and team leadership. Interested in modern Java, Spring Boot. Passionate about designing reliable distributed systems, client-server solutions with optimizing team delivery using agile methodologies.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Central Data Storage(Stealth Startup)	February 2025 - Present

Senior Software Engineer

Modernized and migrated the core healthcare data backup and restore system from a legacy socket-based JavaFX/JSP architecture to a robust, standards-compliant solution using Spring Boot (HTTP/WebSocket) and Flutter desktop, enhancing system scalability, data protection, and regulatory compliance.

Optimized backup storage through de-duplication with Merkle tree-based data integrity checks, resulting in reduced storage costs and improved efficiency.

Delivered new 3.0 MVP in 3 months by driving agile sprints, aligning product vision with engineering, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Enhanced security via token-based authentication and dynamic protocol switching for secure data transfer between doctor’s offices and cloud storage.

Gainsight	February 2023 - February 2025

Senior Software Engineer

Designed and delivered a Rate Limit Service Notification Framework, launching a new pricing model (“pay- as-you-use”) that enabled dynamic scaling and enhanced monetization.

Mentored junior developers and led code review initiatives, improving code quality, onboarding, and team efficiency.

Orchestrated multiple cross-module projects by establishing clear collaboration channels and seamless service integrations.

Gainsight	February 2021 - February 2023

Software Engineer

Contributed to designing and developing Simple Program and Dynamic Program features in Journey Orches- tration, significantly improving customer experience by simplifying the construction of complex use cases.

Key contributor to the redesign and migration of Journey Orchestration from monolith to microservices (Spring Boot Java 8), improving system reliability and scalability by 30

Automated root cause classification for production issues with advanced query categorization in Sumologic, reducing triage time by 30-40

Nomura Research Institute Financial Technologies Pvt.  Ltd	March 2020 - February 2021

Software Engineer

Modernized and refactored batch processing software for Australian Stock Market integration using robust pub-sub architecture, handling high-throughput financial data with multi-threaded Java pipelines.

Delivered key reporting and integration features under strict compliance requirements.



Nomura Research Institute Financial Technologies Pvt.  Ltd	August 2016 - March 2020

Associate Software Engineer

Designed and released REST APIs for Front Office–Back Office sync in Sri Lankan trading project.

Integrated Azure SSO using ADAL4J for enterprise-grade authentication with no service downtime.

SKILLS

Languages: JAVA 8, JAVA 17

Programming: Data Structures, Algorithms, Multi-Threading

Database: Postgres, MongoDB, Oracle, MySQL

Frameworks and Softwares: Spring, Spring Boot, Eclipse, SQL Developer, IntelliJ, Github Copilot, Cursor

Tools: DBQueue, RabbitMQ, Apache ActiveMQ, Apache Tomcat, Sumologic, DataDog

Methodologies: Agile, CI/CD

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering	August 2012 - May 2016 Institute of Engineering and Management, Kolkata.

West Bengal University of Technology, CGPA: 8.67/10.00

ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE

Finalist, Sahamati Hackathon 2021: Developed ”One Ledger Book” personal finance app with new account aggregation API

AIESEC Egypt (2014): Led cultural tourism initiative to boost local engagement.

AIESEC Thailand (2013): Taught English and cross-cultural skills in youth camps.
